description: Defines the Request class for handling HTTP request data in the OrangeHRM API v2, including request method constants, and accessors for request components like body, attributes, and query parameters.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Handles HTTP request data, providing access to request method, body, URL attributes, and query parameters within the OrangeHRM API v2.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Returns the HttpRequest object associated with this request.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing the request body parameters.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for the request body.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing URL parameters.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for URL attributes.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing query string parameters.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for query parameters.

methods.name: getAllParameters
methods.description: Returns all request parameters combined from body, attributes, and query.
